description: A chunky low-poly tracked anti-aircraft tank parked on the ground, seen from the front-left, built with many small separate faceted parts like a detailed game unit. A tank hull with a sloped front plate carrying two small tow hooks and two square headlights inside small cage guards, a flat track guard over each track with no side skirt, and a flat engine deck at the rear with two raised rectangular grille boxes made of parallel slats. On top a tall boxy angular turret set in the middle of the hull with one long slim autocannon barrel mounted on each side of the turret in a boxy gun cradle, both barrels parallel, raised at about 30 degrees and pointing forward and up, each with a flared muzzle tip; on the turret roof at the rear a flat rectangular radar dish on a short post, facing forward, and a small square tracking radar box on the turret front between the guns; a small square commander's hatch with a hinged lid on the turret roof; a cluster of three short smoke-grenade launcher tubes on each front corner of the turret. Along each side a track loop of clearly separate segmented track links over six road wheels each with a raised round hub cap, three small return rollers along the top run of the track, a toothed drive sprocket at the front end and a smooth idler at the rear end. Hull, turret, hatch, track guards, grille boxes and radar post painted one dark grey; both gun barrels, gun cradles, smoke launchers, tow hooks, headlight guards, tracks, road wheels, return rollers, sprocket and idler dark gunmetal, hub caps a slightly lighter grey; radar dish and tracking box a lighter mid grey; headlight lenses pale grey. The engine grille on the rear face faces away and is hidden; the right-hand track and right-hand smoke launchers are hidden behind the hull and turret.
proportions: About 7.7 m long, 3.4 m wide and 3.4 m tall including the raised barrels and the radar; the six road wheels, return rollers, track links and both gun barrels clearly visible. (length : width : height = 2.26 : 1 : 1.00)
sides: the anti-aircraft tank is symmetric left to right: one autocannon in its cradle on each side of the turret, both barrels parallel, raised about 30 degrees and pointing forward; the radar slab on its post at the turret roof's rear on the centre line, facing forward. Six road wheels per side, no side skirt.
